name mkrender (MkRender: mkrhi graphics layer, mkrender renderer)
version v0.10.0 (edd5ba6)
license MIT
licenseFile LICENSE
source https://github.com/MealKit-Engine/MkRender
usedIn engine (rhi, render)
inGame yes
kept CMakeLists.txt, include/, src/, shaders/ (tests and build files are left out; Vulkan headers, volk, VMA, ImGui and Tracy are the engine's)
why MealKit's renderer as engine-free libraries with plain-data inputs: testable without the engine (render goldens) and replaceable. Its own repository like MkUI and MkAudio (docs/ENGINE_MODULES.md "Middleware", docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-11-12).
